name: Dhoby Ghaut
summary: NSL/NEL/CCL interchange — multi-line optionality, park and mall adjacency, and dense condo edges with peak interchange crowds as the tax.
body: Dhoby Ghaut is the shortlist when North-South / North-East / Circle Line interchange access and a position between Fort Canning, Plaza Singapura, and Orchard matter. Housing is mostly condo and serviced edges rather than quiet HDB heartland; peak interchange crowds and weekend mall energy are the tax. Expats land here for car-light multi-line hops and city-core living, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Somerset for a tighter theatre/mall pocket, Orchard for deeper retail spine energy, and Little India / Rochor when you want cultural-belt food with slightly less mall crush.
bestFor: multi-line workers who want Orchard, CBD, and northeast options
households okay with interchange peak crowds
renters who will vet MA parcel locker rules before keys
people booking ActiveSG studios across town without a car
watchOuts: Facility brochure vs MA booking reality
housingMix: Dense condo and serviced-apartment edges with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: North-South, North-East, and Circle Line at Dhoby Ghaut; test a Tuesday 08:15 station exit before you romanticise the interchange.
